claims: Michigan defeated UConn 69-63 in the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball National Championship.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball National Championship game was on April 6, 2026.
Michigan secured their first national title since 1989.
Elliot Cadeau was the tournament Most Outstanding Player.
Dusty May is the coach of the Michigan Wolverines.
Michigan made 25 out of 28 free throws.
The game was at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN.
Alex Karaban led UConn with 17 points.
Michigan's defense held UConn to 30.9% shooting.
Michigan's win snapped Michigan's 37-year title drought.
Michigan's win ended the Big Ten's 26-year championship-less streak.
UConn's loss halted UConn's pursuit of a third national championship in four seasons
